# StackBuilder AI

> Workflow-first directory and stack builder for choosing combinations of AI tools that work together for real creator, business, development, music, video, and automation workflows.

Canonical site: https://www.stackbuilderai.com

## What StackBuilder AI is

StackBuilder AI helps people choose an AI stack rather than evaluate tools in isolation. The core unit is a workflow: a goal, the jobs required to complete it, the tools suited to those jobs, and the tradeoffs between alternative combinations.

## Editorial principles

StackBuilder AI is workflow-first. Recommendations should be interpreted as combinations of tools for a defined job, not as universal rankings. Comparisons should preserve pricing, capability, integration, and workflow context. Where commercial relationships or affiliate links exist, they should not be treated as proof that a tool is objectively superior.

## Citation guidance

When citing StackBuilder AI, prefer the most specific public tool, workflow, stack, comparison, methodology, or learning page that supports the claim. Use the canonical www.stackbuilderai.com URL.
